objective: Invert persisted SEs from the power calibration to compute required sample size (n) for 80% power at pre-specified floors and determine decidability (DECIDABLE_ON_CACHE / UNDECIDABLE_ON_CACHE / INCONCLUSIVE) for the concluded volatility and observed-liquidation nulls using only persisted design quantities. No model re-fit, no sealed-contrast recomputation, no SE re-derivation from raw data, no outcome inspection beyond persisted SEs/design counts.

volatility_forward_2025_disjoint.floor_interpretation: Improvement is a negative change in QLIKE; floor_abs = 0.02 * baseline, baseline = |mean_diff| / (|rel_reduction_pct|/100), taken as persisted in the power-calibration eval.
volatility_forward_2025_disjoint.panel_structure: 5 symbols x ~6168 hourly rows (90 test days x 5 symbols x 3 blocks x 24h contrast-level for primary h24 n=10800)
volatility_forward_2025_disjoint.se_scaling: SE scales as 1/sqrt(n) on contrast-level n_obs; n_req = n_obs * (SE_obs / SE_req)^2
volatility_forward_2025_disjoint.decidability_basis: Compare n_req (contrast-level) to n_available (contrast-level cached, 10800). A larger cached design would require more symbols/blocks/days than available in cache.

observed_liquidation_xsec_forward.se_scaling: SE scales as 1/sqrt(n) on pooled n; n_req = n_obs * (SE_obs / SE_req)^2
observed_liquidation_xsec_forward.symmetry_instability: Pooled null symmetry failed in power calibration (null_mid=-0.0008871690537513768, abs_frac=0.022307243116526917 > 0.01). Report analytic-SE decidability and a symmetry-robust variant using SE_robust = max(|q5|,|q95|)/z_95; flag verdict flip.

required_n_formula.power_equation: power = Phi(|delta|/SE - z_975) + Phi(-|delta|/SE - z_975) = 0.80 at floor

decidability_rule.DECIDABLE_ON_CACHE: n_req <= n_available (a cached design large enough to reach 80% power at the floor exists)
decidability_rule.UNDECIDABLE_ON_CACHE: n_req > n_available (no cached configuration can resolve the floor; structural limit on cache)
decidability_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: SE or scaling unstable / required inputs missing or non-finite

liq_symmetry_robust_rule.report: Report analytic-SE verdict and symmetry-robust-SE verdict; flag whether decidability flips due to instability.

known_answer_self_test: Toy fixture (NOT market evidence): inject known SE/n/delta and assert required-n inversion recovers 80% power at floor.
